image.alt: Sisco Sapena, CEO of Lleida.net, takes part in the panel

children: Almaty, KAZAKHSTAN, September 4, 2026.- Technology services company Lleida.net (BME:LLN, EPA:ALLLN) has presented its digital certification services in Kazakhstan for the first time, on the occasion of its participation in CIS 2026 GCCM Almaty, held from September 2 to 4 at the Royal Tulip Hotel in Almaty.

Organized by Carrier Community (CC), CIS GCCM Almaty is holding its ninth annual meeting this year and is one of the leading gatherings for the wholesale telecommunications community. The event brings together more than 400 members and partners, including decision-makers from Tier-1, Tier-2 and Tier-3 operators from over 36 countries, around the latest wholesale solutions, innovations in data and messaging, and other technological developments in the sector.

Lleida.net held bilateral meetings at table B01, where it presented its certified email, certified call and global messaging routing solutions to local operators and SMS wholesale partners, with a focus on the traceability and evidentiary validity of communications. This first presence of the company in Kazakhstan allowed it to explore new interconnection agreements with partners in Eastern Europe, as well as to strengthen its routes in Spain, Europe and Latin America, markets where Lleida.net holds a well-established position.

On Friday, September 4, Sisco Sapena, CEO of Lleida.net, took part in the executive panel discussion "Network APIs and Fraud Prevention: Strengthening Digital Trust Through Open Network Intelligence," which addressed how technologies such as SIM swap detection, number verification, device geolocation and silent authentication are becoming the first line of defense against identity theft, account takeover and real-time financial fraud.

In his remarks, Sapena pointed out that while network intelligence makes it possible to detect risk, what happened must also be proven with legally irrefutable evidence. This is precisely where Lleida.net can help companies, turning their digital communications and processes into legally valid proof.

Lleida.net is one of the leading European providers of certified notification, electronic contracting and digital signature services. The company holds more than 300 patents in over 60 countries and is listed on BME Growth (Madrid) and Euronext Growth (Paris), as well as in Frankfurt and Stuttgart.
